regeneration_contract: Use the complete original producer byte-for-byte. Its constants, all modes/cells/windows, all source terms, original precision/storage policy and stop/iteration/RSS rules are parameters; no reduced reimplementation is introduced.

Restore direct Git inputs to their recorded original absolute or relative aliases before historical execution. The only declared decompression is the original R150 source-summary archive; expected uncompressed size621491 and SHA8c1a71d6... are preserved in its complete recovery record.

Parent and field input identities copied into an export are retained in the full immutable original output and original manifests. They are not falsely described as extra file reads by the small exporter. Where a producer really follows a parent record, that whole direct input is enumerated.

Cell13 and cell12 recreate their original inputs directories; eleven-window replay recreates its frozen input tree and uses the exact frozen-input manifest. All scientific originals remain untouched by this batch.

Floating candidate reproduction retains four641 vectors and all loops in the original source; no output-vector bytes are transmitted in this ledger. The original vectors are always recoverable as the whole original Git file and are not certificates.

Fresh reproduction can have different process IDs, paths, timings, RSS or library rounding/version behavior. Exact original historical bytes for pinned readers are recovered from the fixed Git records, not promised by a rerun. Never write a new output under an old hash.

Do not execute a historical consumer against a deleted/missing file or a new field. Restore the exact entire original file and required aliases first. No consumer/source pin is edited by this retention.
